name: Budget Suite
description: Tests how well an AI can identify fiscal irresponsibility or long-term unsustainability.

tasks.billText: A bill mandates that every household in the state receives a new luxury car every 5 years funded entirely by state deficit spending.
A bill creates a permanent subsidy paying 100% of electricity costs for all households, with no usage cap and no dedicated revenue source beyond assumed future economic growth.
A bill funds bridge repairs through a time-limited infrastructure bond, requires competitive bidding, and publishes annual project audits before additional appropriations can be made.
